## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.14.5

### 📷 Cameras
- Restores the WebRTC signal relay timing so Home Assistant ICE candidates are sent to X-Sense immediately after the relay offer is sent.
- Keeps the live-view path on the native Home Assistant signal relay instead of the removed local media bridge.

### 🛟 Detector Entities
- Restores the end-of-life entity for the exact smoke, CO, and combination detector models found in the APK device map.
- Keeps non-detector devices from getting lifecycle entities unless X-Sense sends that field in the device payload.

### 🪵 Debug Logging
- Reduces repeated camera ICE candidate debug lines while keeping the candidate counts and relay milestones needed for camera reports.
